item.title: Japanese Microseasons: Niji Kakurete Miezu (虹蔵不見), Rainbows Hide
item.description: Japan's 72 microseasons, or shichijūni-kō (七十二候), divide the year into short seasons of about five days each. Now comes niji kakurete miezu (虹蔵不見): rainbows hide, around November 22 – 26. The light grows thin and low. Rainbows become rare. What can you let rest for now? From GLOBAL INNER DIVINE, a small studio in Japan.

item.title: Japanese Microseason Phone Wallpaper: Niji kakurete miezu (虹蔵不見), rainbows hide
item.description: Niji kakurete miezu (虹蔵不見) — "rainbows hide" — is microseason 58 of Japan's 72, around Nov 22 – 26. A minimalist phone wallpaper with the name written vertically in Japanese, in light and dark versions. Part of a set of all 72 microseasons, one about every five days. Designed in Japan by GLOBAL INNER DIVINE.

item.title: Free Minimalist Phone Wallpapers: Japan's 72 Microseasons, Four Seasons in Light and Dark
item.description: Four free phone wallpapers from Japan's 72 microseasons — first cherry blossoms, first lotus blossoms, chrysanthemums, and the start of winter. Each shows the name of the microseason in Japanese, written vertically, with its reading and meaning. Light and dark versions. Designed in Japan by GLOBAL INNER DIVINE.
